beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Student forms now explain that first and last names should match Pathways, while preferred names can be anything.
• Sample comparison controls are clearer, with the option to delete either sample.

Fixes:
• Preferred names now appear in the verification window, reopened sample headers, progress grid, and exception paperwork. Queued samples use the current preferred name when opened.
• Searching the progress grid now finds students by their preferred names.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
